title: Balance sheet accounts without a reconciliation or supporting schedule
prompt: Which balance sheet accounts have balances but no reconciliation or supporting schedule for the last closed month?

setup.q: Which balance sheet accounts need a reconciliation or schedule every month?
Where are reconciliations and schedules kept when they are not in Dime (folder, workbook, system)?

steps: pull the as-of trial balance for the last closed month
list the bank reconciliations and workpaper schedules Dime holds for that month
run coverage_crosswalk: every balance sheet account with a non-zero balance against the support found
separate "no support found" from "support exists but is not accessible to the desk"

done.text: The Detail sheet lists every balance sheet account with a non-zero balance, and its total ties to Dime's trial balance as of the period end
Every exception row cites the account id and the last place support was looked for
unsupported-balances.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Missing support is told apart from support the desk could not reach; each row says which
